args.body:
Combined summary of two Ironbark articles on retail returns:

• Apparel return rates have climbed to 24%, making returns a major cost driver for retailers (source: blog.ironbark.example/2026/returns).
• Consolidating returns into centralized return hubs cut handling costs by roughly a fifth (~20%).
• Speed matters on the resale side: getting returned goods back on sale within 10 days preserved most of the original margin (source: insights.ironbark.example/returns/companion).
args.title: Ironbark Returns Articles — Combined Summary
